items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I was going around with J.C. Heard, and Jo Jones. That's the three of us that was hanging out together, and we'd go to all these places and we would play.

ctx.x: Was Lester in New York when you were there?

Yeah, Lester was in New York, but it was funny -- I was going around with J.C. Heard, and Jo Jones. That's the three of us that was hanging out together, and we'd go to all these places and we would play. I think Basie -- when I was there at this time, Basie was playing at the Brooklyn Roseland, you know. And I got a chance to sit in on a couple of sets with him, then, you know, and that just blew me away!
